recovery.stopDescription: Stop trying to finish this set-up? Any phone already set up stays set up; you can stop it in the device list. Saved attendance is kept.
recovery.title: Finish setting up this phone
recovery.description: A previous set-up is unfinished. Resume it before starting another.
recovery.reauthorizeDescription: This phone was registered but its secret was not saved. Set it up again to replace the missing secret.

workspace.cachedDescription: The server cannot be reached. Your saved attendee list and saved actions are available while the list is still valid. Reconnect to refresh and to review conflicts.
workspace.title: Offline check-in (no internet)
workspace.description: Only needed when the venue has no signal. Set this phone up while online, record arrivals offline, then sync.
workspace.privacyDescription: Check-in codes contain no name, email address or phone number. The attendee list, the saved actions and this phone's secret are stored scrambled on the device.
workspace.noWallet: If this event offers a time-credit reward for attending, it is given when the person is first checked in, after the saved actions are synced. Otherwise checking in does not change anyone's balance.
workspace.ready: This phone is ready for offline check-in.
workspace.notReady: Offline check-in is not set up yet
workspace.notReadyDescription: Set this phone up while online (above). Checking in by name still works.
workspace.loadErrorDescription: The offline tools could not be loaded. Check in by name instead.

steps.setup: Set this phone up for offline check-in while you still have internet. The set-up lasts about 12 hours; the exact time is shown below.
steps.download: The attendee list downloads to this phone automatically. It lasts about 8 hours and is stored scrambled so nobody else can read it.
steps.record: Record arrivals by scanning each attendee's check-in code, or by pasting the text code. Actions are saved on this phone.
steps.sync: When you are back online, press Sync within 24 hours. The server has the final say; any disagreement appears under Conflicts.

device.title: Phones set up for offline check-in
device.label: Name for this phone
device.register: Set this phone up for offline check-in
device.reasonRequired: Enter a reason before stopping a device.
device.lostDescription: It will be blocked immediately and its copy of the attendee list will stop working the next time it connects.
device.revoke: Stop this device (lost or no longer used)
device.revoked: The device was stopped and its offline data on this phone was removed.
device.empty: No phone has been set up for this event yet.
device.description: Each phone used offline must be set up here first, while online. A set-up lasts about 12 hours.
device.labelHelper: So you can tell the phones apart, for example "front desk phone".
device.registerHint: Creates a secret for this phone and downloads the attendee list. Needs internet.
device.reasonWhy: Needed only to stop a lost phone. The reason is kept on record.

scan.title: Record an arrival by check-in code
scan.description: Scan the attendee's code with the camera, or paste the text code. It is checked on this phone and saved until you sync.
scan.cameraUnavailable: Camera access is unavailable. Enter the code manually.
scan.reasonHint: Required for undo. Do not include sensitive information.
scan.queued: Saved on this phone. Press Sync when you are back online.
scan.invalid: This code cannot be used: it is not a valid check-in code, or it has expired, been replaced, or belongs to another event.
scan.reasonRequired: Enter a reason before saving an undo.
scan.transitionInvalid: That action does not fit what this phone has recorded for the attendee.
scan.alreadyQueued: This code is already saved for that action.
scan.expired: This code has expired. Ask the member to create a new one.
scan.wrongEvent: This code belongs to a different event.
scan.revoked: This code has been cancelled or replaced.
scan.signingKeyUnknown: This code was created after this phone last synced. Sync, then scan again.
scan.queueFull: No more actions can be saved on this phone. Sync before scanning more.
scan.historyRequired: Reopen this check-in screen online to refresh attendance history before using Undo.
scan.reconciliationRequired: Sync the saved actions and reopen this screen online before recording another action.
scan.operationHint: Check in when they arrive. Undo reverses this person's latest change and needs a reason.
scan.queueHint: Saved actions are sent to the server when you press Sync.

queue.stoppedDescription: The server stopped processing this batch. Pending actions are unresolved and remain saved on this phone. Ask an event organiser to compare them with the current attendance before making corrections. Checking the result does not resend them.
queue.processing: Attendance was received and is still being processed. Sync again to check the result.
queue.title: Actions saved on this phone
queue.synced: Synced. The server's answers were applied to each saved action.
queue.syncError: Sync failed. The saved actions are safe; try again when you have internet.
queue.emptyPending: There are no actions waiting to be synced.
queue.empty: No actions are saved on this phone.
queue.purgeDescription: The attendee list, this phone's secret and any unsynced actions will be removed from this phone for good.
queue.readOnlyTitle: Offline check-in has ended on this device
queue.readOnlyExpired: The downloaded attendee list has expired. Nothing new can be recorded, but unsynced check-ins are kept until you remove them.
queue.readOnlyRotated: This phone's set-up was replaced. Nothing new can be recorded, but unsynced check-ins are kept until you remove them.
queue.pendingKept: {{count}} unsynced check-ins are still stored on this device.
queue.pendingKept_one: {{count}} unsynced check-in is still stored on this device.
queue.purgePendingWarning: {{count}} unsynced check-ins will be lost for good.
queue.purgePendingWarning_one: {{count}} unsynced check-in will be lost for good.
queue.readOnlyRevoked: This device is no longer allowed to check people in. Unsynced actions are still saved on this device, read-only, for review.
queue.syncHint: Sends the saved actions to the server. Needs internet. Do this within 24 hours of recording them.

conflicts.title: Conflicts: the server disagrees
conflicts.description: A conflict means an action recorded offline no longer matches what the server holds, for example because the person was already checked in online.
conflicts.error: The record changed again. Refresh and review it.
conflicts.howTo: For each person: type a short reason, then choose Apply offline record or Keep online record.

manual.title: Checking in by name always works
manual.description: Use the attendee list at the top of this screen whenever a code, the camera or the offline set-up is not available.

credential.title: Your check-in code (optional)
credential.description: Create a personal code and show it at the door so staff can check you in quickly. It contains no name, email address or phone number.
credential.load_error: Your check-in code status could not be loaded.
credential.one_shot: For security, the code is shown only once, when it is created or replaced. Save a copy before you leave this screen.
credential.rotate_description: The current code stops working immediately and a new one is shown once. Any saved or printed copy of the old one will be refused.
credential.revoke_description: The code stops working immediately. You can create a new one later while your place is confirmed. Staff can still check you in by name.
credential.reason_required: Enter a reason before cancelling the code.
credential.unavailable: A check-in code could not be created. Check that your place is still confirmed.
credential.privacy: The code contains no name, email address or phone number.
credential.stepsLabel: How to use your check-in code

steps.create: Create the code. Your place must be confirmed.
steps.save: Save it straight away: copy it, share it to yourself or take a screenshot. It is shown only once.
steps.show: Show the QR code or the text at the door. It stops working 24 hours after the event ends.

credential.optional: The code is optional. Staff can always check you in by name.
credential.manage_hint: Replace the code if you lost it or someone copied it. Cancel it if you no longer want one.

errors.revoked: This device is no longer allowed to check people in. Unsynced actions are still saved on this device, read-only, for review.
errors.generic: That offline check-in action could not be completed.
